name: Baby Eyes
problem: Convert sequential photos of resale goods into coherent physical-item groupings and structured candidate listing information without treating detail photos as separate sellable objects.

input.images: Nonempty ordered array of image URLs submitted by a caller; endpoint requires configured AI Gateway key.

output.groups: Array of groups with name, confidence High/Medium/Low, image_indexes, reason, condition, suggested_title, item_specifics, description, verify, hidden_value

guards: Require every input photo index exactly once
Instruct model not to invent rarity/authenticity/dates/variants
Hidden value blank unless concrete attribute warrants checking
Return 502 on invalid model grouping or parse failure
limits: Source inspection does not prove live endpoint or accuracy
Model may hallucinate; human verification needed
Cannot assert authenticity, valuation, or safety from output alone
Gateway use may incur cost; no live calls authorized for this proof
Category-aware autofill candidate PRs are distinct from this main-branch implementation
reuse_validation: Confirm current implementation commit/blob and endpoint behavior
Run isolated fixture with expected grouping and invalid-coverage case, without paid provider calls
Prove field mapping in target consumer; unknown fields remain blank
Human review before publishing or purchasing
Retest accuracy and costs before a new machine consumes the Part
part_identity_rule: The Part is visual item understanding, not the Listing Agent product or the endpoint filename.
